title: artifact.output payload v1
description: One chunk of output the artifact showed the learner (e.g. io:output for a terminal). base64 when the chunk is not clean UTF-8.

labels.description: What the data is, as 'io:<kind>' labels (e.g. io:command, io:output) instead of per-tool event types.

sequence.description: Display order within one artifact session, shared by input and output.
